title: Learn
tagline: The science of lifting, recovery and food — explained for beginners.

paths.title: Before your first workout
paths.blurb: Five short lessons — about 20 minutes — that get you safely through your first session. The rest is there when you're curious.

sections.title: Start here
sections.blurb: How muscle and strength are built, how to read a workout, and what your first two months look like.

lessons.title: How muscles actually grow
lessons.goal: Training is a signal, recovery is when you adapt; mechanical tension and progressive overload are the core drivers.

lessons.title: Sets, reps, rest and RIR: reading a workout
lessons.goal: Decode a program line like '3 x 8-10, 2 RIR, 2 min rest' and know what each part does.

lessons.title: Your first 8 weeks: what to expect
lessons.goal: Early strength gains are mostly the nervous system learning; soreness fades; progress is fast then slows; consistency wins.

lessons.title: Gym myths beginners believe
lessons.goal: Bust toning, spot reduction, 'muscle turns to fat', 'women get bulky', 'no pain no gain', 'more sweat = more fat loss'.

lessons.title: Training safely and gym basics
lessons.goal: Effort vs pain, using safety pins/spotters, gym etiquette, when to see a professional; the not-medical-advice framing.

sections.title: Your body, explained
sections.blurb: Tap through your muscles, see how a muscle contracts, and learn where your energy comes from.

lessons.title: Meet your muscles
lessons.goal: Explore the major muscle groups front and back with the tappable atlas: where each is and what it does.

lessons.title: How a muscle contracts
lessons.goal: Brain to nerve to motor unit to sarcomere; actin and myosin sliding; why lifting heavy recruits more motor units.

lessons.title: Fast and slow muscle fibres
lessons.goal: Type I vs type II fibres, size principle, why both grow with lifting, genetics in plain terms.

lessons.title: Joints, tendons and levers
lessons.goal: Bones, joints, tendons, ligaments; muscles pull on levers; why limb length and range of motion change how a lift feels.

lessons.title: Where your energy comes from
lessons.goal: ATP, phosphocreatine, glycolysis, aerobic system; which dominates a 5 s sprint, a set of 10, a 30 min jog.

lessons.title: Hormones and training, naturally
lessons.goal: What testosterone, cortisol, growth hormone and insulin do; short post-workout spikes matter little; sleep, food and stress matter more.

lessons.title: How your body adapts to training
lessons.goal: Stress, recovery, adaptation; specificity (you get better at what you practise); why progress needs gradually more.

sections.title: Training by body part
sections.blurb: Each muscle group: what it does, the moves that train it, what to think about, and common mistakes.

lessons.title: Chest
lessons.goal: Pec anatomy (upper/mid/lower fibres), what it does, pressing and fly patterns, cues, mistakes.

lessons.title: Back
lessons.goal: Lats vs upper back vs lower back; vertical and horizontal pulls; cues; mistakes.

lessons.title: Shoulders
lessons.goal: Three delt heads and the rotator cuff; pressing, raises, rear-delt work; shoulder-friendly cues.

lessons.title: Arms: biceps, triceps and forearms
lessons.goal: Heads of biceps and triceps, elbow flexion/extension, stretch-position exercises, grip.

lessons.title: Quads
lessons.goal: Four quad muscles, knee extension, squat/leg press/lunge/leg extension, knees over toes is fine, depth.

lessons.title: Glutes and hamstrings
lessons.goal: Hip extension, hinge vs squat, RDLs, hip thrusts, leg curls; the posterior chain.

lessons.title: Calves
lessons.goal: Gastrocnemius vs soleus, straight vs bent knee, full stretch and pause at the bottom.

lessons.title: Core and abs
lessons.goal: Abs, obliques, deep core, lower back; bracing vs crunching; you can't spot-reduce belly fat.

sections.title: Lifting technique
sections.blurb: What to think about during every rep: setup, bracing, range of motion, tempo and effort.

lessons.title: What to think about during every rep
lessons.goal: A before / during / after checklist for any exercise: setup, brace, path, range, tempo, effort, breathing.

lessons.title: The six movement patterns
lessons.goal: Squat, hinge, push, pull, lunge, carry: almost every exercise is one of these.

lessons.title: Breathing and bracing
lessons.goal: 360-degree brace, when to breathe, why it protects and strengthens; when to exhale on light work.

lessons.title: Range of motion and the stretch
lessons.goal: Full range beats half reps for most goals; training at long muscle lengths; control the bottom.

lessons.title: Tempo and control
lessons.goal: Control the lowering, no need for super-slow reps, what tempo notation means, momentum vs cheating.

lessons.title: Warming up
lessons.goal: A few minutes general warm-up plus 2-4 ramp-up sets; long static stretching before lifting is not needed.

lessons.title: Choosing the right weight
lessons.goal: Pick a starting weight, use RIR to judge effort, when to add weight, form breakdown as the stop sign.

lessons.title: Focus: mind-muscle connection
lessons.goal: Internal focus can help muscle growth on isolation moves; external focus helps strength and skill.

sections.title: Planning your training
sections.blurb: Progressive overload, how many sets, how often, how hard — and what to do when you stall.

lessons.title: Progressive overload
lessons.goal: Doing a bit more over time; double progression (reps then weight); other ways to progress.

lessons.title: How many sets? Training volume
lessons.goal: Weekly hard sets per muscle; dose-response with diminishing returns; a beginner starting range.

lessons.title: How often: frequency and splits
lessons.goal: Training each muscle about twice a week; full body vs upper/lower vs push-pull-legs; pick what you'll stick to.

lessons.title: How hard: effort and failure
lessons.goal: Sets need to be close to failure to count; you don't need to hit failure every set; safer exercises for going to failure.

lessons.title: Plateaus and deloads
lessons.goal: Why progress stalls, a troubleshooting checklist (sleep, food, effort, program), what a deload is.

lessons.title: Cardio and lifting together
lessons.goal: Cardio's health benefits, the small interference effect, how to schedule both, steps and daily movement.

lessons.title: Tracking your progress
lessons.goal: Why logging matters, what to track (weights, reps, body weight trend, photos), using LiftLog to do it.

sections.title: Recovery
sections.blurb: You grow between workouts: sleep, rest days, soreness, stretching, massage and managing stress.

lessons.title: What recovery actually is
lessons.goal: Muscle repair and protein synthesis over the next day or two; fatigue vs fitness; recovery is where adaptation happens.

lessons.title: Sleep: the best recovery tool
lessons.goal: Sleep need for adults, effects of short sleep on strength, hunger and recovery; practical sleep hygiene.

lessons.title: Rest days and active recovery
lessons.goal: How much rest between sessions for the same muscle, active recovery like walking, you don't need to rest completely.

lessons.title: Muscle soreness (DOMS)
lessons.goal: What DOMS is, why it's worst for beginners and new exercises, soreness is not a measure of a good workout.

lessons.title: Stretching and flexibility
lessons.goal: Static vs dynamic stretching, when each is useful, lifting through full range also builds flexibility.

lessons.title: Foam rolling and massage
lessons.goal: Short-term feel-good and range-of-motion effects, small effect on soreness, it does not 'break up' fascia or flush toxins.

lessons.title: Stress, fatigue and overreaching
lessons.goal: Life stress adds to training stress; warning signs of doing too much; true overtraining is rare in beginners.

lessons.title: Pain vs soreness vs injury
lessons.goal: Telling normal effort and soreness apart from injury warning signs; modify instead of stopping everything; when to see a professional.

sections.title: Nutrition
sections.blurb: Calories, protein, carbs and fats, food groups, vitamins — and how to eat to gain muscle or lose fat.

lessons.title: Calories and energy balance
lessons.goal: Calories in vs out decides weight change; what burns calories (BMR, NEAT, exercise, digestion); why scale weight fluctuates.

lessons.title: Macros: protein, carbs and fat
lessons.goal: The three macronutrients, kcal per gram (4/4/9, alcohol 7), what each does for a lifter.

lessons.title: Protein: how much, and from where
lessons.goal: A science-based daily protein range for lifters, spreading it over meals, best food sources compared.

lessons.title: Carbs, fibre and fats
lessons.goal: Carbs as training fuel, fibre, whole vs refined, healthy fats and essential fats; neither carbs nor fat is the enemy.

lessons.title: Food groups: building a plate
lessons.goal: Vegetables and fruit, whole grains, protein foods, dairy, fats; the plate method including an Indian thali version.

lessons.title: Vitamins, minerals and water
lessons.goal: What micronutrients do, common gaps (vitamin D, B12 for vegetarians, iron, calcium), staying hydrated.

lessons.title: Building muscle as a vegetarian
lessons.goal: Protein quality, combining sources, Indian vegetarian protein foods compared, reaching the target without meat.

lessons.title: Bulk, cut or recomp?
lessons.goal: Choosing a goal, a sensible surplus or deficit, how fast to gain or lose, using the estimator, adjusting by trend.

lessons.title: Meal timing and the 'anabolic window'
lessons.goal: Total daily intake matters most; pre- and post-workout meals; the narrow anabolic window is a myth.

lessons.title: Reading labels and building habits
lessons.goal: Read a nutrition label, serving sizes, a few simple habits that beat strict diets.

sections.title: Supplements
sections.blurb: What actually works, what's a waste of money, and how to buy safely. Food first, always.

lessons.title: Do you need supplements?
lessons.goal: Food first; supplements are small add-ons; the evidence tier list; quality and third-party testing; natural-only scope.

lessons.title: Creatine
lessons.goal: What it is, what it does, monohydrate 3-5 g a day, loading optional, safety and myths (hair, kidneys, water).

lessons.title: Protein powder
lessons.goal: It's just food in powder form; whey vs plant; when it helps; it counts toward daily protein.

lessons.title: Caffeine
lessons.goal: Performance effect, typical dose ranges by body weight, timing vs sleep, tolerance and safety limits.

lessons.title: Vitamin D, omega-3 and other basics
lessons.goal: When vitamin D, omega-3, B12, iron or a multivitamin make sense; test before you supplement; avoid megadoses.

lessons.title: What to skip
lessons.goal: BCAAs when protein is adequate, 'testosterone boosters', fat burners, detox teas: why they're not worth it and the risk of contamination.
